observations: Read revised primary in full after additions; original full text previously recovered/read and previous working edition compared. No alternatives exist.

All five logic exhibits, worm, Bark Sisters, PVC stop/reroute, speech, plant/calls, food and final exchange retained. Comedy additions grow from original gloves/tennis balls and blanket fetch; two comic callbacks give Buddy a chosen role.
Sequencing repaired so stone ring and sapling are in place before Heather puts balls on deck and Buddy counts them. New planted image will not anticipate planting.
Speech image after Buddy hungry confirmation keeps completed dialogue attribution and illustrates the existing pause, before Neet resumes. Retained image remains immediately at seated PVC pause.
Final ending unchanged; no blend with S068 wedding. Expanded length remains close to prior with short physical incidents rather than replacement monologues.

Opened original N19/N24/B29/B04. Smooth close photographed coats govern rather than generated engraved texture. Neet fine limbs support full body; Buddy stride shows moderate torso length and substantial legs.
Opened rendered standing and paired models; connected limbs/body planes provisionally useful. Finish calibration is style support only; keep coat simpler than its visible internal strokes.

Two complete drawn panels inspected. Speech Neet pelvis rests on ground with forelimbs reaching low box; Buddy forepaws, haunch and chest connected on blanket. Human legs and hands are separate audience.
Planting panel: four owned Buddy feet on deck, full torso and continuous neck lowered to exactly two balls; Neet has four fine supported legs behind and beside newly planted bed.
Speech: remove premature stone ring because stones added only after speech, keep petal-ring shallow pit.
Speech: Neet drawn tail projects left; reduce to tiny near-flush nub.
Both: replace all graphite directional hatching on torso/legs with smooth broad wash; retain regional Buddy muzzle/ear furnishings.
Every current finished image opened at full resolution against original photos; concrete findings recorded per image.

observations.finding: Neet converts trapped glove dirt into successful topsoil transfer and a PVC obstruction into logistics; Buddy pauses, rescues his balls and notes the worm is first to arrive somewhere. The quiet lost gap in Bark Sisters commentary varies the timing. Buddy has his own imperfect logistics, especially backing into the podium and alternately putting down balls. Sagar and Heather each get understated missing-utensil reactions before helping.

The five objections anticipate the actual sprinkler obstruction. The impossible tunnel exposes Neet wanting inclusion, which leads directly to Heather inviting the speech and Sagar organizing a feasible backyard ceremony. Planting and calls make a practical continuation of the India connection. Ball-counting payoff precedes meal and nap, leaving the final faith/practicality exchange room to land.

illustration-v004 follows Neet sitting at the exposed PVC, before he stands to redraw. Both dogs look down at an intact white pipe; helmet, gloves, ground cord and two balls match. speech-art-v003 follows Buddy complete Correct attribution and precedes speech continuation, with blanket, lights, petal-ringed open hole and no premature stones/sapling. delegation-art-v004 follows planting and Heather placing both balls on deck: two balls, planted stone bed, bareheaded Neet, retired helmet and gloves; no hand still giving balls or exposed pipe.

The first image makes the grand mission small against a shallow pipe. The second changes composition and social scale to an earnest makeshift ceremony with listening humans. The third gives foreground space to Buddy solemnly counting two balls, with Neet and completed planting behind. They advance distinct beats rather than repeat portraits.

The current first image visibly uses smooth broad coat planes on both dogs. Engraved curly torso strokes rejected in v002 do not recur at intended reading size. All current image hashes match the independently accepted visual-review-v002 record, including actual v004 reinspection. Speech and delegation images retain regional Buddy furnishing without shaggy body silhouettes.

S057 remains the Austin backyard attempt to reach an India wedding retroactively. No Piedmont venue, ring pillow, tuxedos or guest dogs were imported from S068. The incompatibility remains unresolved; this review grants no chronology or canon decision.

Provenance and recovery source pins remain present. Final footer still describes proposals awaiting review, accurately representing its pre-integration stage; parent may update delivery/status wording after integrating this review. No owner approval is claimed.
